The existing VCS diagnosis and boundary-trace files are not actionable current evidence: the diagnosis applicability report is historical_only because a bound source hash changed and its gate binding does not match the current failure. Its recorded timescale error must not be patched unless a fresh authorized execution reproduces and localizes it.

All operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer gates have live hash-validated pass evidence. No current trace challenges those certificates, so neither lower layer may be reopened or replayed now.

The connected kernel is certified as an elastic rate-insensitive token pipeline with all 13 required boundary orders and required cross-token overlaps observed. Board integration must not impose strict same-cycle starts or finishes across unequal-latency stages.

The target-weight catalog, independent target-model reference, semantic testbench, and lower-layer weight evidence passed, but a board-level pass still requires current hash binding to the same immutable checkpoint, stimulus, reference outputs, numeric tolerance, testbench, complete Transformer-block weight scope, exact wrapper, and executed loader/consumption evidence.
The absent board_axi_ddr semantic-evidence report is a downstream consequence of the skipped board execution. It cannot be synthesized from lower-layer results, random expected data, or RTL output.

sacg_memory_truth lists 16 active contamination barriers and six open retry requests for this scope, including retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140, retry_request.0141, retry_request.0142, retry_request.0143, and retry_request.0144. They remain downstream trust and promotion blockers until checker-mediated reconciliation after a passing current Stage7 run.

There are no open backtrack requests in the authoritative current board scope. The one globally persisted cross-layer backtrack request is outside this prompt scope and is not an executable blocker here.
The conditional design-team router returned no_split. No specialist review or consensus exists that could replace the missing deterministic board evidence.
proposed_actions: Deterministically rebind the board simulation manifest to the current exact identity document, Vivado export facts, ordered compile contexts, and an already-authorized simulator executable; then rerun case_axi_ddr_interface.
If exact compile authority cannot be derived or multiple candidates remain, record a Stage6 contract backtrack or bounded approval request rather than guessing.

After the interface gate passes, run a fresh exact-board VCS replay with existing non-invasive boundary monitors on the immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, numeric policy, testbench, wrapper, and source hashes.

If that execution fails, localize the earliest current board causal boundary before selecting any implementation repair. Apply only a contract-preserving board integration, loader, harness, instrumentation, or runtime correction and replay the same transaction.
Create a lower-layer backtrack only if the fresh board trace explicitly contradicts a named certified invariant; otherwise keep both lower certificates closed.

After the current board replay passes, run every remaining board-layer functional, deadlock, AXI, DDR, data-order, numeric, transfer-count, address-map, weight-consumption, and semantic-evidence gate, then reconcile the six open retries and 16 active trust barriers through SACG checkers.
risks: Editing the tool profile to authorize an arbitrary simulator, inventing Vivado export contexts, or hardcoding board/module/path names would bypass the failed authority check instead of repairing it.
Using stale diagnosis output or the dependency-skipped boundary trace could misclassify a harness or compile-contract defect as RTL behavior.

Changing the checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, expected outputs, comparison tolerance, semantic testbench, or exact sample-project wrapper/source set would invalidate the repair loop. Tolerance must not be derived from DUT output or loosened to obtain a pass.
A simplified AXI/DDR wrapper could hide board-specific address, width, ordering, reset, lifecycle, or DDR-image failures and is forbidden.

Cross-layer mismatches may still emerge after execution among model shape, numeric representation, tensor/data order, DDR layout, loader/runtime ABI, generated integration, AXI protocol, and exact board facts. These require current trace evidence before a code repair is selected.

AXI or prefetch activity alone cannot establish core ingress, output-frontier progress, lifecycle completion, value correctness, or a board pass. A frontier stall is localization evidence, not a preselected RTL root cause.

A board output symptom alone cannot invalidate the connected-kernel certificate. Reopening it requires current source hashes, direct core start, accepted ingress, egress, a named causal boundary, and an explicit contradiction against the current certificate.
The active SACG barriers prohibit downstream consumption of rejected verification and repair artifacts as validated inputs. They must not be manually cleared merely because a new repair plan exists.

constraints: Do not reopen certified lower layers without a current trace that explicitly contradicts a named invariant.
Preserve elastic variable-latency connected-kernel boundary order and cross-token overlap; unequal stage start or finish cycles are not failures by themselves.
Keep checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy and tolerance, semantic testbench contract, and exact sample-project wrapper/source hashes immutable during this repair loop.
Use the exact user-supplied board wrapper and Vivado export evidence; do not substitute a simplified wrapper or guess module, path, export-context, or executable names.
Expected outputs must come from the independent target-model execution on the same checkpoint and stimulus; random data or DUT output cannot serve as expected output.
DUT and golden scope is Transformer blocks only; embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work remain excluded.
